text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tonight, terrifying monsters
shall creep up upon you...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Looook... I'll curse you
tooo~~!!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
...Cuuuut!! That rehearsal was perfection!
Man, I'm so glad we asked you to star in this!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much~
I'll be sure to do a splendid job as the PR lead for "Heart-Pounding☆Horror Night."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today was the filming day for the amusement park's promotional event video.
Super Creek and the others, dressed as monsters, were apparently going to "attack" the park's guests.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...So, why the heck are me and Trainer,
who were just spectating, participating as extras?!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's Creek's big moment after all.
...Guess I've got no choice. Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thank you both so much~.
Let's make this a fun video together♪

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
All right, this is the scene where the extras run for their lives!
4... 3... 2... Action!

text_block_list.name: Werewolf
text_block_list.text: Awoooooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Zombies
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh... Ooooh...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: "...Come now, with me... into an eternal slumber...!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~! Even if it's fake, it's crazy impressive!
Alright, I'm ready to be scared out of my wits!

text_block_list.name: Zombies
text_block_list.text: Waaahhh... aaaaahhh~~...!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaa~~~h!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh...!? I wonder if Tama-chan... is all right.

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Next is the forest scene! Here, the werewolf
goes chomp and sinks his teeth right into the Academy Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Werewolf
text_block_list.text: Grrrrrr... Gaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I... I...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I can't stand by any longer!
Get away from the two of them, Mr. Werewolf!

text_block_list.name: Werewolf
text_block_list.text: G... Grrr?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What the heck are ya talkin' about all of a sudden?!
You're the mummy that's s'posed to be attackin'!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No no... I'm not a mummy, I'm your mommy~.
Were you scared? Are you hurt anywhere?
I'll wrap bandages all around the parts that hurt♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what...! We weren't really
scared at all, and we didn't get bitten either, ya hear?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, just leave everything to Mommy~.
I'll give you plenty of headpats later♪

text_block_list.name: Werewolf
text_block_list.text: G-Grrrrrr... Gwaaaah~~!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Oh my, for children who can't get along...
I'll cast a spell on you to turn you into good kids~!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: ......Cut, cuuuuuuuut!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Eh, ah, I'm sorry!
I completely forgot we were in the middle of a photoshoot—

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: You guys are... THE ABSOLUTE BEST!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, seriously?!
Creek's ad-lib was way too over the top, wasn't it?!"

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
OK! An emotional blockbuster about a Mommy awakening to motherhood!
That was a magnificent performance!
This video is gonna go viraaall!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? I just couldn't
leave those two on their own...

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
That natural vibe was what made it so great!
Don't you think so too, Academy Trainer?
choice_data_list: I think it was so very like Creek, and I loved it!
I don't think that would really help promote the event, though...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Really? Oh, what a relief then~

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's keep this momentum going!
Please continue right from the scene where the mummy awakens to its maternal instincts!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Umm... something like this, perhaps—?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Tama-chan... there, there, good girl...
Let me pamper you~~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's not acting at all!
You're scarier than any monster!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, the heartwarming video went viral,
and the event was reportedly a massive hit right from day one!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I-I knew it...!
I'm sorry for acting on my own.

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, we'd like to ask for the standard pattern as well!
...Shall we start from the scene where the werewolf attacks?!

text_block_list.name: Werewolf
text_block_list.text: UGRAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaah! Heaven protect me!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
N-No, absolutely not!
Please don't lay a hand on those two~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, after doing several retakes,
we somehow managed to wrap up the shoot...!
